identity.name: Type XX
identity.one_liner: The 2023 Type XX reissue with the in-house caliber 728 flyback chronograph — the 1950s French Air Force navigation chronograph reissued in a 39mm civilian case.

narrative.story: The Type XX (Type 20 in French) was originally specified by the French Air Force in the 1950s as a navigation chronograph; Breguet, Dodane, and Airain all produced versions. Breguet's civilian Type XX has been in the catalogue since the 1960s, and the 2023 reissue (Type 20) houses the new in-house caliber 728 flyback chronograph — a column-wheel, vertical-clutch movement with a 60-hour reserve. The 39mm steel case and the bidirectional 12-hour bezel are the 1950s originals. The Type XX is the most-cited Breguet sport chronograph and the watch a collector cites when they want a military-heritage flyback.
narrative.collector_notes: The caliber 728 (2023) replaces the earlier 582 used in the previous Type XX. The flyback function allows resetting and restarting the chronograph without stopping it first.
